sourceTitle: Beet Salad With Peppers and Lettuce
sourceText:
Beet Salad With Peppers and Lettuce
By: gypsy696
Published: Tuesday, December 21, 2010 - 6:39am

Ingredients




1 beet
1 orange pepper
1 red pepper
2 cups red leave lettuce
Handful of sunflower seeds
Dressing:
1 teaspoon olive oil
1 tablespoon maple syrup
1 teaspoon fresh basil, finely chopped

Preparation

1 Chop the peppers and lettuce into thin slivers. 2 Chop the beets into circular discs, so that they remain the star of the salad and get their moment in the sun. 3 Mix all the salad ingredients. 4 Add the salad dressing just prior to serving.  5 Garnish with sunflower seeds.
